name: supabase-tools
description: Portable toolkit for local Supabase development: Docker services, migrations, snapshots, ERD, tests, and docs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/sdk && npm run build -w packages/ui-web && npm run build -w packages/plugin-migration-studio && npm run build --workspaces && tsx scripts/copy-dashboard.ts
scripts.test: vitest run --config packages/sdk/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/core/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-erd/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-typegen/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-db-test/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-depgraph/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-migration-audit/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-frontend-usage/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-deno-functions/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/plugin-migration-studio/vitest.config.ts
